result:
`billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint` (same value) everywhere it was used, and the change is live. PR #1 on `mono` merged with CI green, and CD on `main` succeeded. A grep of `apps/` and `libs/` finds no `billingUrl` left.

**What changed:** four files in `mono`: `libs/shared-contracts/index.js`, `core-shell`, `sub-route-billing` and `sub-route-reports`. I did not start any apps myself; the check that they still start is CI's build of the apps.

**Assumptions:**
- `platformkit` needed no change. It has no reference to the setting, so I only noted that as a sub-task and opened no PR there.
- `libs/shared-contracts` is built into each app at build time, so no version bump or dependency update was needed.
- The reports app is not deployed by CD. I updated it anyway so no reference remains.

**What slowed me down:**
- My first two `st pr open` attempts failed because I left out the repo key and branch arguments. The usage text showed the right form.
- `st status` still shows both sub-tasks as `todo`. I found no command to mark them complete.
